source: ODV database/dynasty_dump.sql.gz · political_dynasties and verified relationships tables, supplemented with cited public office records for Duterte family members
scope: Winner-marked elected office records in archived ODV data for national and local offices from 2004–2025, supplemented with published role records for Rodrigo Duterte and family members where ODV is missing or mislabels their offices. Online supplementation includes Duterte barangay captain service and 2019/2022/2025 election roles; it does not make the national ODV roster complete. This is not a 2028 candidate list.
recordsScope: The records array contains NO-marked officeholders only. The families object retains linked historical family-member office records for context.

method.noVoteRule: NO means at least two distinct ODV-linked family members held office in the same modeled calendar year. A family with exactly one local and one national officeholder in that year is excluded. This Dapat Isa Lang–inspired screen is applied only to verified ODV relationships or shared ODV dynasty_family_id; shared surnames alone do not count.
method.officeLevels: President/vice president, senators, and House/party-list representatives are classified as national. Governors, vice governors, mayors, vice mayors, provincial board members, and councilors are classified as local.
method.terms: President/vice president and senators are modeled as six-year terms; other included elected positions as three-year terms, based on the election year in ODV. Partial final calendar years are included in overlap checks.
method.familyLinks: Uses ODV relationship records marked verified=true (family relationship types 1–20) and source dynasty_family_id values. Where ODV lacks a verified edge, direct Duterte family relationships are linked from cited public biographies and election reporting; shared surnames alone are not used.
method.limitations: The archived ODV records are incomplete and vary by election year and office. Online additions currently repair Duterte roles only; the wider 2019 winner-marked roster remains incomplete, and 2022/2025 local-office coverage is sparse. Some source rows or relationships may still be omitted or misclassified. NO years use inclusive modeled calendar-year windows; check the linked evidence and official records before relying on a marker. No NO means this incomplete screen found no qualifying overlap, not that no political family link exists.

documentedFamilyLinks.basis: Publicly documented Duterte family relationships; no shared-surname matching.
